family_reports.body: By endorsing factually impossible recommendations and ignoring documented non-compliance, the current legal process has systematically deprived my children of stability and safety while allowing their developmental milestones to be traded for high-conflict trauma.

It destroyed me ruined my quality of life . The constant targeting has made me feel unsafe . And in constant worry for my children's safety. I miss my children so much. It's caused intense grief because of the intense powerlessness. I almost went to prison and I was all over the news for a crime I didn't commit I lost my animals as well. I was getting death threats and constant harassment.

public_comments.comment_text: He was my youth judge when I was a minor as a foster kid . And he was the judge that had my kids in the system when they were taken at birth. And while I was pregnant with my 2nd child they orchestrated a criminal case against me falsely to discredit me when I had my 2nd child. They forced me to sign legal documents so I wouldn't go to prison but they used my false confession to take my kid . And I was all over the news . They removed it from the internet but it was there at one point. This judge never cared about proof . He only cared if cps filed the right paperwork and agreed with everything cps said. And wouldn't let me defend myself.
